description.zh: 配额提升申请的阿里云账号（主账号）。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account for which the quota increase is requested.
The ID of the quota application batch.

description.zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：30。
description.en:
The maximum number of records to return for the current query.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30.

description.zh:
用来标记开始查询数据的位置。

> 不设置该参数，表示从头开始。
description.en:
The token that marks the position from which the query starts.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProducts](~~440555~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).

description.zh:
配额种类。取值：
- CommonQuota：通用配额。
- FlowControl：API速率配额。
- WhiteListLabel：权益配额。
description.en:
The quota type. Valid values:

- CommonQuota: General quota.

- FlowControl: API rate limit quota.

- WhiteListLabel: Privilege quota.

description.zh:
配额提升申请的审批状态。取值：

- Disagree：拒绝。

- Agree：审核通过。

- Process：审核中。

- Cancel：已关闭。
description.en:
The approval status of the quota increase request. Valid values:

- Disagree: The request is rejected.

- Agree: The request is approved.

- Process: The request is in review.

- Cancel: The request is closed.

title.zh: 查询配额模板批量配额申请详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications-detail-for-template --aliyun-uid 1350483376110000 --product-code ecs --quota-action-code ecs.c5.large --status Agree --batch-quota-application-id d314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000 --quota-category CommonQuota --next-token 4 --max-results 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas ListQuotaApplicationsDetailForTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'ecs.c5.large' --Status Agree --NextToken 4 --ProductCode ecs --BatchQuotaApplicationId 'd314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000' --AliyunUid 1350483376110000 --QuotaCategory CommonQuota --MaxResults 30
